title: Failure: a Postgres sink with a wrong password does not complete
summary: Submits local -> postgres with a wrong password in the DSN. The job must not be COMPLETED, the error must say the login failed without containing the password, no table may be created, and the failed attempt must be visible in the run history.

steps.title: Drop e2e_bad_password
steps.explain: Starts clean so every row counted later was written by this run.

steps.title: Submit the job through the API
steps.explain: POST /api/v1/jobs with the TOML base64-encoded, exactly as the console does.

steps.title: Wait for the run to finish
steps.explain: Polls the task result and GET /api/v1/runs until this run reaches a terminal status.

steps.title: Job is not COMPLETED
steps.explain: A sink that cannot log in delivered nothing.

steps.title: Error says the password was refused
steps.explain: The user must see the real cause.

steps.title: The password is absent from the task result and run record
steps.explain: A wrong password is still a secret.

steps.title: Look for the target table
steps.explain: Nothing may be written with a refused login.

args.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'e2e_bad_password'

steps.title: The failed attempt appears in GET /api/v1/runs
steps.explain: Run history must show failed jobs, not only the ones that got far enough to start a run.
